morphe_force_premium.name: Force Pro (all entitlements)
morphe_force_premium.description: Unlocks every Pdb Pro feature and hides paywalls.

morphe_no_ads.name: Block all ads
morphe_no_ads.description: Disables every ad SDK and the in-app ad loader.

morphe_privacy_receipts.name: Disable IRL read receipts
morphe_privacy_receipts.description: The other person never sees that you opened their IRL.

morphe_privacy_see_more.name: Ignore IRL "see more"
morphe_privacy_see_more.description: Stop IRL view tracking when you expand a card.

morphe_remember_auth.name: Stay signed in
morphe_remember_auth.description: Remember the Google sign-in so you are not asked again (Pdb's own switch).

morphe_force_offer.name: Force offer sheet (dev)
morphe_force_offer.description: forceShowOffer — makes Pdb show its offer/paywall sheet again.

morphe_api_staging.name: Use staging backend (dev)
morphe_api_staging.description: apiIsStaging — points the app at Pdb's staging API. Separate accounts/data.

morphe_show_full_error.name: Show full error messages
morphe_show_full_error.description: Surface the complete error toast instead of a generic one (debug aid).

morphe_im_connect_toast.name: Stream connect toast
morphe_im_connect_toast.description: Toast when the realtime (IM) socket connects (debug aid).

morphe_force_english.name: Force English
morphe_force_english.description: Force the app UI to English regardless of system locale.

morphe_advanced_logging.name: Verbose file logging
morphe_advanced_logging.description: Raise the app's file logger to Info level.

morphe_global_pause.name: Pause all Morphe extras
morphe_global_pause.description: Stop writing any values; leave the app untouched on next launch.

morphe_geo_country.name: Feed country override
morphe_geo_country.description: mockFeedCountryCode — for example US, GB, DE. Empty = off.

morphe_whitelist_host.name: Web allow-list host
morphe_whitelist_host.description: whiteListHost — extra host the in-app browser may load. Empty = off.

morphe_bubble_url.name: Bubble entry URL
morphe_bubble_url.description: mockBubbleEntranceURL — repoints the bubble entry. Empty = off.

morphe_mock_latlng.name: Mock GPS location
morphe_mock_latlng.description: mockLatLng — lat,lng, for example 51.50,-0.12. Empty = off.

morphe_instant_chat_user.name: Force instant-chat partner
morphe_instant_chat_user.description: debugInstantChatUserId — user id to be matched with instantly. Empty = off.
